import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static long gcdCalc(long a, long b) {
        while (b != 0) {
            long temp = b;
            b = a % b;
            a = temp;
        }
        return a;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int a = sc.nextInt();
        int b = sc.nextInt();
        int n = sc.nextInt();

        int num = 0;
        int den = 1;
        double minDiff = 1e9;

        for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
            int low_i = (j * a) / b - 1;
            int high_i = (j * a) / b + 1;
            for (int i = low_i; i <= high_i; ++i) {
                double diff = Math.abs((double) i / j - (double) a / b);
                if (diff < minDiff) {
                    minDiff = diff;
                    num = i;
                    den = j;
                }
            }
        }
        long g = gcdCalc(Math.abs((long) num), den);
        System.out.print((num / g) + "/" + (den / g));
        sc.close();
    }
}
